Published online:

Synopsis:
    Kansas City Fed President Jeff Schmid (non-voter 2026) flagged persistent, broad-based inflation running ~double the 2% target as "concerning" and the primary monetary policy focus. He rejected the transitory narrative, cautioned against over-weighting one softer CPI print, and flagged renewed oil price pressure as a risk. The Fed meets July 28-29; markets price a rate hike in September. New Fed Chair Kevin Warsh is withholding forward guidance. Schmid emphasized Fed transparency as essential to institutional accountability.
